summary: Critical violation: Task explicitly requires bats-core testing framework and 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT', but deliverable uses custom bash fixture runner with no .bats files. Workflow doesn't run bats or generate act-result.txt. Error-handling bug in run-fixtures.sh: set +e (lines 45, 58) never restored with set -e, breaking error propagation across loop iterations. Large inline jq programs (matrix-generator.sh lines 88-97, 117-136) reduce maintainability. Missing explicit actionlint validation step in workflow. Fixture runner has repetitive generator invocations (lines 45-55 vs 58-73) that should be factored. No evidence of red/green TDD methodology required by task.
